Write a cleaning report to a text file

write_cleaning_report.Rd

Create a text file summarising the state of the data set after cleaning. It optionally compares the dimensions before/after and records the provided statistics.

Usage

write_cleaning_report(
  data,
  original_data = NULL,
  file = "cleaning_report.txt",
  stats_list = NULL
)

Arguments

data

The cleaned (final) data.frame.

original_data

(Optional) The raw data.frame (before cleaning) to compare removed rows.

file

Path to the output file (e.g. "reports/cleaning_log.txt").

stats_list

A named list of counters or messages (e.g. list(outliers_capped = 12, rows_removed = 5)).

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the created file.

Details

The report contains:

  • The date and time of the report.

  • The dimensions of the final data set.

  • The number of remaining missing values (NA) per column.

  • A section of operational logs displaying the counters provided in stats_list.

See also

Other Export functions: export_csv()

Examples

# Raw data
df_raw <- data.frame(id = 1:5, val = c(10, NA, 30, 1000, 50))

# Cleaned data (example)
df_clean <- data.frame(id = c(1, 3, 4, 5), val = c(10, 30, 100, 50))

# List of operations performed (collected during the script)
my_stats <- list(
  "NA imputed" = 1,
  "Outliers capped" = 1,
  "Rows removed" = 1
)

# Generate the report
tmp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
write_cleaning_report(df_clean, original_data = df_raw, file = tmp_file, stats_list = my_stats)
#> Error in write_cleaning_report(df_clean, original_data = df_raw, file = tmp_file,     stats_list = my_stats): could not find function "write_cleaning_report"

# Read the result
cat(readLines(tmp_file), sep = "\n")
